newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna plans options on Boehler, Creditanstalt.
newsitem.headline: Vienna plans options on Boehler, Creditanstalt.

text.p: Vienna's futures and options exchange (OeTOB) said on Monday it planned to introduce options on shares of steel maker Boehler-Uddeholm and common stock of Creditanstalt-Bankverein by November 18.

"We hope that November 18 will be the first trading day," spokesman Johan Schmit told a news conference. But he added OeTOB so far had only secured two market makers in the options, and was still looking for the required third one.
With the two new contracts, OeTOB would be offering options on ten of Vienna's 21 blue-chip ATX stocks.
